title: 第157章 唯一
slug: 求生游戏请叫我诚信商人
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

李知讶异。

翡翠宝箱开出本源，西莉亚好像都没什么感觉。

怎么一个划取权反而如此大惊小怪。

“翡翠山脉的划取权还有其他附加价值？”

西莉亚几口可乐将卡在气管的一粒米饭咽了下去，才用扯着已经咳得自带电音的破锣嗓子道：“你知道翡翠山脉是因为翡翠死了才形成的吧？”

李知：“知道。”

当时翡翠之心出现时，详细信息里写的是“某位天启族天赋析出后的结晶”，当时她就想过，天赋都析出了，人肯定是没了。

后来西莉亚也证实了这一点。

翡翠确实死了，只是留了部分本源在星月长廊。

现在，西莉亚再提此事，显然另有含义。

“所有人都知道星月长廊能够保存强者之心拥有者带有一部分意识的本源，但千百年来，能真正与她们沟通的人很少，这些人询问的问题得到的答案也差不多，所以大家开始怀疑，这些本源，是否真的有主人的意识。”

李知若有所思道，“所以你之前说的沟通，其实不是有思想的交流，只是对话而已。”

西莉亚打了个嗝：“所有人都说天启族不死不灭，但直到今天，也没人真正见过一个天启族完整的一生，即便是自愿将力量归还大地的翡翠，也并不会回答进入星月长廊的强者的每一个问题。”

“所以，大家对于翡翠的猜测，是她的本源保留了她的部分过去的意识和性格，但无法感知现在发生的一切。”

“翡翠喜欢不服输的孩子，在过去的百年里，在翡翠山脉觉醒强者之心的人数，是天启大陆其他区域的总和，足足有771人。”

“你是其中一人。”

“翡翠喜欢你，这并不奇怪。”

Page (1/3)

Li Zhi was surprised.

The emerald treasure chest opened its source, but Celia didn't seem to feel anything.

Why is there such a fuss over a right of demarcation?

"Is there any other added value to the demarcation rights in the Emerald Mountains?"

Celia swallowed a grain of rice stuck in her trachea with a few sips of Coke, and then said in a broken gong voice that was already making an electric sound due to coughing: "You know that the Emerald Mountains were formed because the Emerald died, right?"

Li Zhi: "I know."

When the Emerald Heart appeared, the detailed information stated that it was "the crystallization of a certain Apocalypse's talent." At that time, she thought that once the talent was separated, the person would definitely be gone.

Celia later confirmed this.

Jade is indeed dead, but only part of its origin is left in the Xingyue Corridor.

Now, when Celia mentions this matter again, it obviously has another meaning.

"Everyone knows that the Star-Moon Corridor can preserve some of the conscious origins of the owners of the Heart of the Strong, but for thousands of years, very few people have been able to truly communicate with them, and the answers to the questions asked by these people are similar, so everyone begins to doubt whether these origins really have the consciousness of their owners."

Li Zhi said thoughtfully, "So the communication you mentioned before is actually not an exchange of ideas, but just a dialogue."

Celia burped: "Everyone says that the Apocalypse tribe is immortal, but until today, no one has really seen the complete life of an Apocalypse tribe. Even Jade, who voluntarily returns his power to the earth, will not answer every question of the strong man who enters the Star-Moon Corridor."

"So, everyone's guess about Jade is that her origin retains part of her past consciousness and personality, but she is unable to perceive everything that is happening now."

"Jade likes children who refuse to admit defeat. In the past hundred years, the number of people who have awakened the heart of the strong in the Jade Mountains is the total number of people in the rest of the Apocalypse Continent, a total of 771 people."

"You are one of them."

"It's not surprising that Jade likes you."
